title: Python code for: Perturbation algorithm and iterative realization of a four-layer semi-discrete scheme for an evolutionary problem with a variable operator

creators.name: Vashakidze, Zurab
creators.affiliation: The University of Georgia; Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University

description:
Python implementation of the algorithms and of the numerical experiments of the article D. Gulua, J. Rogava, Z. Vashakidze, Perturbation algorithm and iterative realization of a four-layer semi-discrete scheme for an evolutionary problem with a variable operator, Proceedings of I. Vekua Institute of Applied Mathematics, Vol. 76, 2026.

The code solves the Cauchy problem u'(t) + (A + B(t)) u(t) = f(t) in a Hilbert space, where A is self-adjoint positive definite and B(t) is a bounded time-dependent operator. It contains the perturbation algorithm, which reduces the purely implicit four-layer scheme (three-step backward differentiation formula, BDF3) to three two-layer schemes; the four-layer scheme itself; and the iterative realization in which only the time-independent operator I + τA is inverted. The script run_experiments.py reproduces the data of all tables and figures of Section 7 of the article (Tables 7.1–7.4, Figures 7.1–7.3); self_test.py and diagnostics.py check the implementation and the hypotheses of the theorems. On Windows, run_Python.bat runs everything in one step.

Requirements: Python ≥ 3.8 and NumPy ≥ 1.20. Equation and theorem numbers in the code follow the arXiv version of the article; the README gives the correspondence with the journal version.
notes: The third author, Z.V., was supported by the Shota Rustaveli National Science Foundation of Georgia (SRNSFG) under grant number FR-25-215.
